item.title: Version 1.2.1
item.description:
ParkShelf 1.2.1

  • Glyph legibility improved.
  • Fixed window dragging on macOS 27.

ParkShelf 1.2.1

  • Park individual Chrome tabs. ParkShelf can move the active Chrome tab onto the shelf and later return that same live tab to its original Chrome window automatically.
  • Your browsing state stays intact. Parked Chrome tabs are moved rather than recreated, preserving the live page, history, login state, and scroll position.
  • Safari remains window-based. Safari does not provide the same live-tab movement capability, so ParkShelf safely parks the complete Safari window. An alternative solution for Safari users is in development.
